posts.title: Wicked: For Good at the Majestic King’s Lynn and the ancient art of foyer promotion
posts.description: We went to see Wicked: For Good in the Majestic in King’s Lynn last week. The Majestic is a glorious survival from what I guess you might call the ‘golden age’ of cinema going. It was built in 1927 and is still running as an independent. posts.title: British Silent Film Festival Symposium 2026 (Call for Papers)
posts.description: The British Silent Film Festival Symposium 2026 will take place on Friday 10th April at the Cinema Museum in Kennington.
